t: A small Pyrenean state created in 1278 when the bishop of Urgell and the count of Foix agreed to share its lordship.
For centuries a poor community of herders and smugglers, it kept its autonomy by staying neutral between France and Spain.
A constitution in 1993 made it a sovereign parliamentary co-principality; it joined the United Nations the same year.
dyk: Andorra is the only country where Catalan is the sole official language, and one of its two heads of state is the bishop of a Spanish diocese.
ev: The first Pareatge establishes joint lordship by the bishop of Urgell and the count of Foix
The Consell de la Terra, forerunner of the Consell General, is created
Henry IV joins the Foix co-princedom to the French crown
Napoleon restores the French co-princedom abandoned in 1793
The Nova Reforma widens the electorate to all heads of household
A new constitution is approved by referendum and Andorra joins the United Nations

f.founder: Pere d'Urtx, bishop of Urgell, and Roger-Bernard III, count of Foix
